title: web/public/ghs/: the nine GHS hazard pictograms, public domain

components.name: GHS hazard pictograms (UNECE), Wikimedia Commons' SVG copies
components.statement: GHS01.svg to GHS09.svg are unedited copies of Wikimedia Commons' GHS-pictogram-*.svg files (converted from UNECE's EPS files), which Commons marks public domain as ineligible for copyright.
components.evidence: Commons API, 2026-10-29: each of the nine pages has the licence template {{PD-ineligible}} (wikitext) and extmetadata LicenseShortName 'Public domain', License 'pd', Copyrighted 'False', AttributionRequired 'false'; Credit 'EPS file <name>.eps from UNECE web site converted with ImageMagick convert and with potrace, edited in inkscape'. The SHA-1 of each shipped GHS0n.svg equals the current Commons version's SHA-1 (explos 49deeaed…, flamme 47a26281…, rondflam a09ecfa7…, bottle 5bb4e2ce…, acid 8bcb729f…, skull c1eac17d…, exclam a6e24513…, silhouette 12a0d526…, pollu f38551d2…), so they are unedited. THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and src/panels/ghsPictograms.ts say the same. No notice is required.
